_comment: Mutation testing gate. Line coverage proves tests EXECUTE code; mutation score proves they DETECT changes to it. A surviving mutant is a missing assertion. Scope is the retrieval core with dedicated unit tests — mutating all 338 source files would take hours and say nothing actionable. Widen as coverage grows.
_comment_static: ignoreStatic: static mutants (code evaluated at module load) force a full process restart each — Stryker measured 140 of them, 49% of mutants consuming 85% of runtime, which exhausted memory on a 15GB machine. They are excluded from the score; the reported MSI covers runtime mutants only. Revisit if the excluded set grows.
